note: Semantic cue sets — a NESTED (tree) section schema, distinct from the flat seed/token sections. Layer 1 = colour category (positive/neutral/negative), HSL-derived so it rides the theme. Layer 2+ = sub-categories distinguished by icon (and name), inheriting the parent's colour. Extensible: a child may itself carry children. Authored in content as COMPOUND classes gated under html.ab-theme — `.positive.advise`, `.negative.warn` — where the layer-1 class paints the card + colour and the layer-2 class swaps the icon. Colour defaults derive via the formulas below (theme-formula-map.md 2.6); icons are per-node tokens; every value is a pivot hook (L5/L6 override wins over the formula). Worked implementation: ab-semantics.less. Fold-tool auto-generation of this nested shape is a follow-up (the fold tool currently projects flat sections).

derive.note: Per layer-1 set X, from its hue + the shared dials. Emitted as --ab-base-pf-default-<X>-<token>, hooked to --ab-base-<X>-<token>.
